systems.title: System thinking and long-horizon strategy
actions: Identify the system boundary, actors and feedback loops
Separate leading indicators from final outcomes
Model 2 viable alternatives and major risks
Choose a reversible test and its decision threshold
systems.metric: Evidence-backed decision quality and measured downstream outcome

learning.title: Evidence-informed spaced learning
actions: Define one observable performance skill
Practice retrieval from memory instead of rereading only
Interleave a second related problem type
Review on days 1, 3 and 7, adjusting to measured errors
learning.metric: Unaided recall and new-problem transfer, not speed multipliers

apprenticeship.title: Expert mentoring by deliberate practice
actions: Assess current work samples against explicit rubric
Break work into novice-to-advanced milestones
Assign one realistic simulation or real-world exercise
Independently review and revise based on errors
apprenticeship.metric: Rubric scores on authentic tasks and error recurrence

reflection.title: Decision journal and metacognitive feedback
actions: Record decision, assumptions and date before outcome
Identify counterexamples and confidence calibration
Compare predicted and observed results
Change a process only when there is evidence
reflection.metric: Calibration, decision outcomes and repeated-error rate

life_design.title: User-directed priorities and sustainable routines
actions: Ask which values and goals the user explicitly selects
Map calendar/energy constraints without sensitive assumptions
Design one optional habit with a sustainable workload
Review user-reported usefulness; preserve autonomy
life_design.metric: User-chosen goal progress and subjective usefulness, self-reported

leverage.title: High-leverage work and realistic constraints
actions: Find repeated steps and identify bottleneck with observed evidence
Prioritize reuse, delegation or automation by risk and cost
Pilot one reversible low-cost change with quality gates
Measure actual time saved, correctness and new overhead
leverage.metric: Measured time saved net of review costs, quality and reliability

aspiration.title: Values-aligned long-term development
actions: Translate desired future identity into optional observable behaviors
Choose one near-term milestone and supportive context
Rehearse with a small real-world task
Evaluate progress and revise without psychological claims
aspiration.metric: User-defined behavior completion and measured progress
